title: MedSecure AI : Cybersecurity Command Center
summary: A hackathon demo cybersecurity and privacy-preservation prototype for healthcare EHR data, combining a synthetic data generator, a blockchain audit ledger, and a honeypot defense system. Its backend GAN engine directly imports SDV's SingleTableMetadata and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to fit on uploaded patient CSVs and sample 100 synthetic records for HIPAA-safe data anonymization.
